_meta._note: S210 Kimi K3 tech report re-analysis. Model already has 48 scores (mostly Artificial-Analysis-sourced). This adds NET-NEW benchmarks from Table 2 (main comparison), Table 5 (3rd-party) that Kimi K3 lacked; existing AA-sourced values (gpqa/hle/aa_lcr/scicode/critpt/gdpval/apex etc.) NOT overwritten to avoid clobbering with the report's own (slightly different) numbers. Skipped: Kimi in-house Table-3 benches (24/7 ClawBench, MIRA, KAET, CLIF, Swarm, Deep Research Bench, KWV, etc. — single-vendor, no cross-model value under strict attribution), cyber exploit suite (in-house, metric-ambiguous), Agent Arena (net-improvement scale conflict). Baselines (Fable 5 / GPT-5.6 Sol / Opus 4.8 / GPT-5.5 / GLM-5.2) are 2nd-hand -> not ingested.
